subject: Project update
text:
Project update: the vendor dashboard moved to staging yesterday, and the login flow looks stable after the cookie fix. The reporting export is still my unfinished task because the date filter returns mismatched rows when the timezone changes. I reproduced it on two accounts and wrote notes in the tracker, but I need until Thursday to test the patch. The design review did not happen; the lead rescheduled it to Friday after the client asked for the security summary first. Do not share the staging link yet; the placeholder legal text is still visible. I will send the export file once the filter works. If the client pushes the demo again, tell them we will show the read-only version only, not the editable layout. The budget sheet also needs one correction before the archive copy is filed. I have the invoice numbers but not the delivery receipts, so the totals cannot be locked. The accessibility check passed for headings and contrast, though the focus order needs one more pass. I added the revised copy to the shared folder, and the tester will review it before noon.
Thanks, M
